listing.name: Legend of Legaia / legend-of-legaia-recomp
listing.summary: Register an independently permitted prepared Legend of Legaia Windows playtest copy with your own USA disc, extracted executable and US PlayStation BIOS; preserve its creating runtime and external state.

steps.title: Complete the exact original and BIOS setup upstream
steps.instruction: Use an independently permitted complete Windows playtest copy. Supply your own legally dumped USA disc: extracted SCUS_942.54 in disc/, matching CUE/BIN in game/, and your own US SCPH1001.BIN in bios/. The documented CUE name is Legend of Legaia (USA).cue; retain the matching game.toml if your upstream working copy uses another path. A filename is not a whole-disc identity certificate. Portcove obtains or extracts no disc, executable, BIOS or helper.

steps.title: Attach the completed native player
steps.instruction: The upstream v0.1.7 diagnostic-playtest README explicitly supports direct LegaiaRecomp.exe with its complete creating player directory as working directory and no extra arguments; keep SDL2.dll and bundled game.toml, settings.toml, bios/, disc/, game/ and matching resources together. Do not attach the batch file, package script, compiler or a setup-host output. Complete preparation upstream first. Retain supported literal arguments already required by your working copy; no renderer or input mode is newly qualified.

steps.title: Keep launch and maintenance ownership explicit
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact native executable, established CWD and literal arguments; request Play separately. The reviewed source provides the normal in-process launcher/runtime route; package build flags and package-to-source correspondence remain unverified. Independently started setup, helper, mod-preparation or successor sessions remain upstream activity outside this attachment. Close every actual player and companion before maintenance, retain the old runtime/data and review or relink changed selected bytes. Removing registration preserves all external files.

steps.title: Preserve the actual creating profile and custom roots
steps.instruction: The title config selects runtime memcard_dir=saves. The named runtime source anchors normal runtime files to the executable directory and supports --memcard-dir plus settings-selected explicit card paths; preserve the actual effective directories and card1.mcd/card2.mcd, rather than assuming all state is under saves/. Retain all saves/states, settings.toml, game.toml and custom overlays, original disc/BIOS/extracted executable, cache or overlay shards, mods, logs, crash/hitch/manual reports, backups and temporary files with the creating runtime. Preserve external custom card/disc/BIOS/mod paths. No cross-version card/state compatibility or migration is established.

steps.title: Keep experimental qualification and existing scheduling visible
steps.instruction: This is an early diagnostic playtest with documented hitch investigation and a static-overlay fallback; upstream reports are not Portcove observations. Keep the supported creating configuration and runtime together. The retained owner-approved 1.0 product-priority deferral and stable-player/source/runtime/write acceptance remain for independent review; this guide does not claim those conditions resolved or create a beta commitment. Upstream and you own preparation, runtime replacement and recovery; no external update, backup, rollback, migration, deletion or diagnostic upload is offered.

warnings: Only attach actual originals, runtime and components you are independently permitted to use. Runtime PolyForm Noncommercial terms and SDL/dependency notices apply separately; no source label or upstream package assertion grants Sony/game rights.

Source/README/config and retained release digest metadata only: no package download, archive/PE inspection, acquired-source-to-binary certificate, actual title launch, save, game, installed-client, Supported or protected acceptance. Do not infer uninspected runtime build flags or immutable package contents.
